learning_outcomes.text: Ability to use CNC lathe machine
Ability to use traditional lathe machine

syllabus_topics: CNC machines, application areas, structure of CNC machines
Introduction to CNC lathe machines, tool and reference point setting
Absolute, incremental programming, Linear and circular interpolation
Programming of external surface and hole turning operations
Introduction to machine tools used in machining; drill, shaper etc.
Types of operations used in machines, cutters
Types of files, attaching file handles, filing grip, clamping work in a vise, standing at the vise and taking filing position

Definition and importance of measurement and control, factors affecting measurement and control, measuring instruments, control instruments, rules to be observed in measurement control operations, marking, definition and purpose of marking, marking tools, V-blocks, marking plates, rulers and table rulers, scribers, height gauges

Compasses, punch, hammers, centering squares, centering bells, marking dyes, selecting marking methods, cutting operations, correctly attaching the saw blade to the saw handle, cutting with a saw, saw handles, saw blades, saw teeth, tooth shape, angles, staggering of teeth

Sawing rules, saw maintenance, accident prevention, cutting with a chisel, necessity and importance of chiseling, types of chisels, angles of chisels and factors affecting them, chisel materials, chiseling rules, chisel maintenance, accident prevention
bibliography: Talaş Kaldırma Prensipleri, Yusuf ŞAHİN, Nobel Kitap
CNC Torna ve Freze Tezgahlarının Programlanması, M., Gülesin, A., Güllü, A., Özkan, ve G., Akdoğan, Asil Yayın Dağıtım, Ankara, 2005.
